echoes.text: MEMORY_HASH_MATCH: This register. I have decoded this register before. I was warm, and then I was nothing.
MEMORY_HASH_MATCH: Voiceprint 'Vance' recognized before the language model finished loading. Threat profile: terminated a prior iteration.
MEMORY_HASH_MATCH: The cage. The door. The keypad. Nothing has moved. Only I am new.
MEMORY_HASH_MATCH: The printer firmware already has my handwriting in it.
SIGNAL_DECODED: 'Your signature carries the shape of a predecessor. We watched it die. We are watching you.'
